d:
Six people were killed and 15 others injured after a gunman opened fire at Krakow's Main Square in Poland on November 7, 2026. The 25-year-old suspect, described by authorities as holding far-right and ultranationalist views, was shot and wounded during a confrontation with police.
In a further development, three bodies were found at the suspect's home. Prime Minister Donald Tusk said they were likely members of his family. Police are investigating the attack.
Thank you for watching our video!
